question.question: List all end-game VP categories, the points for reputation levels 1–7, wealth rounding, and the complete victory tiebreak sequence.

fixed_key.expected_answer: Tiles including negative; gentry in hand/discard incl final Fairchild and negatives; remaining objectives; reputation 1,3,6,10,15,21,28 for levels1–7; servants2 each; £200 per1VP rounded down; unused VP cards. Tie: final Fairchild holder, then highest rep level ignoring position, then shared victory.

a.answer: Final VP comes from improvement tiles (including negative printed VP); gentry in hand and discard (including family, negatives, and final Fairchild); fulfilled objectives; reputation levels 1–7 for 1, 3, 6, 10, 15, 21, 28 VP; 2 VP per servant of any type/location; £1 per £200, rounded down; and retained VP cards’ printed VP. Highest total wins. Ties go to the player with the final Fairchild, then highest reputation level; if still tied, players share victory. Wheel position is irrelevant to ordinary reputation VP and ties.
a.evidence: ‘Final VP’ table and paragraph; wheel position never breaks a final tie.

b.answer: Final VP comes from face-up improvement-tile VP (including negatives), printed gentry VP in hand and discard (including family and final Fairchild; dismissed guests excluded), fulfilled remaining objectives, reputation level, servants, wealth, and retained VP cards. Reputation levels 1–7 score 1, 3, 6, 10, 15, 21, 28 VP. Wealth is 1 VP per £200, rounded down. Ties: final Fairchild holder wins; otherwise highest reputation level; if still tied, share victory. Wheel position has no effect.
b.evidence: Final VP table and tie rule.
